title: SignalForge Expression Schema v1
description: Documentation-only JSON-Schema description of M7's yaml expression schema v1. Runtime validation is performed by ExpressionValidator (src/expression/expression_validator.cpp), not by this document. Mirrors M5's decoder_schema_v1.json pattern.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier. Must be 1 for V1.

description.description: Optional free-form description of this expression file's purpose.

expressions.description: Sequence of expression definitions. Each entry is independently validated, then cycle detection runs across the union.

id.description: Unique identifier. Must not collide with any base-signal id in the registry. Must be a valid exprtk identifier ([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*) so other expressions can reference it by name.

name.description: Optional human-readable name. Defaults to `id` when omitted.

unit.description: Optional unit string (e.g., 'V', 'W', 'A'). Empty string for dimensionless or boolean signals.

formula.description: exprtk-compatible expression. Allowed operators: arithmetic (+ - * / %% ^), comparison (< > == != <= >=), logical (and or not xor). Allowed math built-ins: min, max, abs, sqrt, log, log10, exp, sin, cos, tan, floor, ceil, round. Forbidden: control flow (if/while/for/?:/switch), user-defined functions, string operations, exprtk built-ins outside the whitelist (sgn, cot, statistical aggregates), local var definitions, side-effect assignments.

type.description: Output type for the derived signal. `double` is identity. `bool` maps non-zero to true. `int64` rounds via std::round; out-of-range values produce a warning + 0.

description.description: Optional free-form description of this expression's purpose.

$comment: Frozen at M7 close. Modifications to the keys/types above require a new ADR. Whitelist additions for `formula` (e.g., new exprtk built-ins) are non-breaking and may be added without ADR per spec §6.2.
